accepted_mc2: unchanged MC2-E (no rho/anchor/dynamics/variance change; lifecycle, if admitted, branches futures only via new RNG domains)
accepted_status_contract: v3.2j-driver-status-v1 frozen; J Retired=True exclusion keeps absolute precedence; Stopped never retirement evidence

admission_gates.calibration: reliability adequate across folds; ECE reported per fold; no admission on ROC alone; high terminal probability never becomes deterministic retirement
admission_gates.causal_definition: STOPPED_UNRESOLVED_AT_T definable from feed delta semantics with a scientifically derived freshness boundary (not coverage-tuned)
admission_gates.coverage_value: admitted scope must be material relative to complexity; trivial gain -> report honestly, do not integrate
admission_gates.finish_classification: complete mutually exclusive positions definable without final-result labels, else BLOCK
admission_gates.last_state: return branch initializable from last valid canonical anchor + explicitly modelled lost time/distance; no pretending stale state is current
admission_gates.opportunity_materiality: lifecycle-addressable checkpoints counted before modelling; immaterial -> V3.2L COMPLETE OPPORTUNITY IMMATERIAL
admission_gates.return_state: return transition produces a causally defensible resumed state (no teleport, no fabricated gaps)
admission_gates.temporal_safety: future-poison invariance of features, P(terminal), and return-time distribution at T

candidate_models.return_time: stratified empirical conditional survival P(additional downtime | age A, context) BEFORE any ML regression
candidate_models.terminal_return: logistic regression FIRST (small, interpretable); more complex only with preregistered justification (none pre-authorized)

coverage_rules.eligibility: every stale offender J-retired OR admitted-lifecycle-representable, plus all other blockers pass; no partial roster

finish_order_semantics.proposal: rank by simulated (-laps, race_time) within a finish-rule extension carrying an explicit terminal flag; final-result labels never used
finish_order_semantics.requirement: complete mutually exclusive positions without historical results, else BLOCK integration

frozen_at: 2026-10-07 (before constructing training labels from future outcomes)
lifecycle_state_definition: STOPPED_UNRESOLVED_AT_T: at T the driver is causally known stopped/non-progressing, not J-Retired, with last known race state sufficient to initialize a lifecycle process; NOT retired/DNF/will-not-return

mc_integration_semantics.return_branch: no competitive progress while stopped; resume from last-known anchor transformed only by simulated elapsed future
mc_integration_semantics.terminal_branch: simulated-future non-progression; NOT an assertion of retirement at T

seeds: deterministic fixed seeds; no unseeded RNG
simulation_counts: research-arm comparisons on frozen evaluation population; no fixed 5000-run population sweep; counts preregistered per experiment at run time in artifacts
stopping_rules: lifecycle state not causally definable -> REJECT
immaterial opportunity -> report honestly, do not weaken gates

target_population.definition: exact 3294 primary-STALE checkpoints from frozen J coverage_after.json (corpus 8229a8606)
target_population.offenders: parsed from frozen reason strings; K reconciliation (2866/147/281) recomputed, never regenerated as conclusion

temporal_folds.design: season-forward; episodes from one race never cross train/eval; no random row splits

RETURNED.definition: competitive progression resumes (future lap completion observed)

TERMINAL.definition: no competitive return before session termination under frozen label definition

x_features_allowed: last known position / lap / lap deficit
last known pit state / pit-stop count
last known tyre state if causal
